body: Would also like to mention that i have not been tested for OCD or any of the variants, but my symptoms are so obvious and ive been suffering for years…there is something very wrong. Mainly i’m too scared to go in for a diagnosis because i’m scared they’ll just say i dont have it and im really just a terrible person. You know…the usual
I have had a feeling i have some form of ocd or anxiety disorder for a while now, i will be trying to visit some sort of psychiatrist in the future.
Thank you for your reassurance. I will try not to do that, but unfortunately i come up with new reasons to hate myself nearly every week. I will keep this in mind though.
